title: Czechia: Czech Budget Battle: Looser Fiscal Rules and NATO Spending Put Prague's… · 04 Sep
keywords: Czech Republic, fiscal policy, deficit, NATO, defense spending, Czech National Bank, Eurostat, inflation, EU fiscal rules, public finances, Prague, budget, borrowing, Stability and Growth Pact
notes: The Czech government is pushing toward a more expansionary budget path, loosening borrowing constraints to fund investment and rising defense costs, even as growth remains soft. The dual pressure of higher deficits and NATO commitments is reshaping Prague's fiscal priorities in ways that will affect public services, borrowing costs, and household finances for years to come. Critics warn that debt-financed politics risk becoming normalized, while the government argues that tightening now would only deepen economic stagnation.
